<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Inventory;

use App\Actions\Accounting\PostDoubleEntryJournalAction;
use App\DTOs\Accounting\JournalEntryData;
use App\DTOs\Accounting\JournalLineData;
use App\Enums\JournalType;
use App\Models\AccountingPeriod;
use App\Models\ChartOfAccount;
use App\Models\JournalEntry;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockLedgerEntry;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use InvalidArgumentException;

final class RecordBatchPurchaseInboundAction
{
    private const FUNDING_ACCOUNT_CODES = ['1-1102', '2-1101'];

    /**
     * Catat barang masuk / restock multi-produk secara batch dalam satu transaksi atomik.
     * Mengupdate stok & HPP setiap produk, mencatat buku besar persediaan (StockLedgerEntry),
     * dan memposting jurnal ganda yang seimbang ke kas / utang usaha.
     *
     * @param array<int, array{product_id: int|string, qty: int|float|string, price: int|float|string}> $items
     * @return array{journal_entry: JournalEntry, total_amount: string, items_count: int, processed_products: array}
     */
    public function execute(
        array $items,
        string $accountId,
        string $createdByUserId,
        ?string $invoiceNumber = null,
        ?string $notes = null,
    ): array {
        if (empty($items)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Daftar barang masuk tidak boleh kosong.');
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use (
            $items,
            $accountId,
            $createdByUserId,
            $invoiceNumber,
            $notes
        ): array {
            $productIds = array_map(
                static fn (array $item): int => (int) ($item['product_id'] ?? 0),
                $items
            );

            if (count(array_unique($productIds)) !== count($productIds)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Produk yang sama tidak boleh muncul lebih dari satu baris.');
            }

            $coaCashOrDebt = ChartOfAccount::where('id', $accountId)->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();

            if (! in_array($coaCashOrDebt->account_code, self::FUNDING_ACCOUNT_CODES, true)) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Akun pendanaan harus Kas Besar atau Utang Usaha.');
            }

            $period = AccountingPeriod::where('is_closed', false)
                ->orderBy('start_date', 'desc')
                ->first();

            if ($period === null) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Tidak ada periode akuntansi terbuka untuk mencatat pembelian.');
            }

            $products = Product::with(['unit', 'inventoryAccount'])
                ->whereIn('id', $productIds)
                ->where('is_active', true)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->get()
                ->keyBy('id');

            $totalInvoiceAmount = '0.0000';
            $journalLines = [];
            $ledgerEntriesToCreate = [];
            $processedProducts = [];

            foreach ($items as $itemData) {
                $productId = (int) $itemData['product_id'];
                /** @var Product|null $product */
                $product = $products->get($productId);

                if (! $product) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Produk dengan ID {$productId} tidak ditemukan atau tidak aktif.");
                }

                $rawQty = trim((string) $itemData['qty']);
                $rawPrice = trim((string) $itemData['price']);

                if (! preg_match('/^\d+(\.\d{1,4})?$/', $rawQty)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Kuantitas untuk produk {$product->name} tidak valid.");
                }

                if (! preg_match('/^\d+(\.\d{1,4})?$/', $rawPrice)) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Harga beli untuk produk {$product->name} tidak valid.");
                }

                $qty = number_format((float) $rawQty, 4, '.', '');
                $price = number_format((float) $rawPrice, 4, '.', '');

                if (bccomp($qty, '0.0000', 4) !== 1) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Kuantitas untuk produk {$product->name} harus lebih dari 0.");
                }

                if (bccomp($price, '0.0000', 4) !== 1) {
                    throw new InvalidArgumentException("Harga beli untuk produk {$product->name} harus lebih dari 0.");
                }

                $lineSubtotal = bcmul($qty, $price, 4);
                $totalInvoiceAmount = bcadd($totalInvoiceAmount, $lineSubtotal, 4);

                $oldStock = (string) $product->current_stock;
                $oldAvgCost = (string) $product->average_cost;
                $newStock = bcadd($oldStock, $qty, 4);

                $newAvgCost = bccomp($newStock, '0.0000', 4) > 0
                    ? bcdiv(
                        bcadd(bcmul($oldStock, $oldAvgCost, 4), bcmul($qty, $price, 4), 4),
                        $newStock,
                        4
                    )
                    : $price;

                $product->update([
                    'current_stock' => $newStock,
                    'average_cost' => $newAvgCost,
                    'last_purchase_price' => $price,
                ]);

                $unitCode = $product->unit ? $product->unit->code : 'UNIT';
                $formattedQty = rtrim(rtrim($qty, '0'), '.');
                $formattedPrice = number_format((float) $price, 0, ',', '.');

                // Siapkan baris jurnal debit untuk akun persediaan produk
                $journalLines[] = new JournalLineData(
                    chartOfAccountCode: $product->inventoryAccount->account_code,
                    debit: $lineSubtotal,
                    credit: '0.0000',
                    lineDescription: "Masuk {$product->name} ({$formattedQty} {$unitCode} @ Rp {$formattedPrice})",
                );

                $ledgerEntriesToCreate[] = [
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'pos_shift_id' => null,
                    'reference_type' => 'PURCHASE',
                    'qty_change' => $qty,
                    'balance_before' => $oldStock,
                    'balance_after' => $newStock,
                    'unit_cost' => $price,
                    'total_value' => $lineSubtotal,
                    'created_by' => $createdByUserId,
                    'created_at' => Carbon::now(),
                ];

                $processedProducts[] = [
                    'product' => $product->fresh(),
                    'qty' => $qty,
                    'unit_cost' => $price,
                    'subtotal' => $lineSubtotal,
                    'new_stock' => $newStock,
                    'new_average_cost' => $newAvgCost,
                ];
            }

            if (bccomp($totalInvoiceAmount, '0.0000', 4) !== 1) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Total pembelian harus lebih besar dari nol.');
            }

            // Tambahkan baris kredit tunggal untuk sumber dana (Kas Besar / Utang Usaha)
            $invLabel = $invoiceNumber ? " [Faktur: {$invoiceNumber}]" : '';
            $journalLines[] = new JournalLineData(
                chartOfAccountCode: $coaCashOrDebt->account_code,
                debit: '0.0000',
                credit: $totalInvoiceAmount,
                lineDescription: "Kredit {$coaCashOrDebt->account_name}{$invLabel}",
            );

            $journalNumber = $this->nextJournalNumber();

            $descParts = [
                'Barang Masuk Multi-item (' . count($items) . ' produk)',
            ];
            if ($invoiceNumber) {
                $descParts[] = "Faktur: {$invoiceNumber}";
            }
            if ($notes) {
                $descParts[] = $notes;
            }
            $description = implode(' | ', $descParts);

            $journalData = new JournalEntryData(
                journalNumber: $journalNumber,
                accountingPeriodId: (string) $period->getKey(),
                posShiftId: null,
                entryDate: Carbon::now(),
                journalType: JournalType::PURCHASE,
                referenceType: 'BATCH_PURCHASE',
                referenceId: null,
                description: $description,
                lines: $journalLines,
                createdByUserId: (string) $createdByUserId,
            );

            /** @var JournalEntry $journalEntry */
            $journalEntry = app(PostDoubleEntryJournalAction::class)->execute($journalData);

            // Simpan data kartu stok ledger dengan referensi ke id jurnal
            foreach ($ledgerEntriesToCreate as $ledgerData) {
                $ledgerData['reference_id'] = $journalEntry->id;
                StockLedgerEntry::create($ledgerData);
            }

            return [
                'journal_entry' => $journalEntry,
                'total_amount' => $totalInvoiceAmount,
                'items_count' => count($items),
                'processed_products' => $processedProducts,
            ];
        });
    }

    private function nextJournalNumber(): string
    {
        $sequence = JournalEntry::count() + 1;

        do {
            $journalNumber = 'JRN-' . Carbon::now()->format('Ymd') . '-'
                . str_pad((string) $sequence, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
            $sequence++;
        } while (JournalEntry::where('journal_number', $journalNumber)->exists());

        return $journalNumber;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Actions\Inventory;

use App\DTOs\Accounting\JournalEntryData;
use App\DTOs\Accounting\JournalLineData;
use App\DTOs\Inventory\SpoilageData;
use App\Enums\JournalType;
use App\Enums\ShiftStatus;
use App\Models\AccountingPeriod;
use App\Models\ChartOfAccount;
use App\Models\JournalEntry;
use App\Models\PosShift;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ServiceBom;
use App\Models\SpoilageLog;
use App\Models\SpoilageLogItem;
use App\Models\StockLedgerEntry;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

final class RecordSpoilageAction
{
    /**
     * Catat barang rusak / gagal produksi, potong stok, dan posting jurnal beban
     * kerusakan sesuai jenis persediaan yang terdampak.
     */
    public function execute(SpoilageData $data): SpoilageLog
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data): SpoilageLog {
            $posShift = PosShift::where('id', $data->posShiftId)
                ->where('status', ShiftStatus::OPEN->value)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->firstOrFail();

            $failedOutputQty = $this->normalizePositiveQty($data->failedOutputQty, 'Jumlah output gagal');

            // Hitung total biaya kerusakan dan kumpulkan item yang terbuang.
            $items = [];
            $totalCost = '0.0000';

            if ($data->spoilageSource === 'SERVICE_PRODUCTION') {
                if ($data->serviceId === null) {
                    throw new \DomainException('Layanan jasa wajib dipilih untuk kerusakan produksi.');
                }

                $serviceBoms = ServiceBom::where('service_id', $data->serviceId)
                    ->where('is_required', true)
                    ->get();

                if ($serviceBoms->isEmpty()) {
                    throw new \DomainException('Layanan yang dipilih tidak memiliki resep bahan baku (BoM).');
                }

                foreach ($serviceBoms as $bom) {
                    $rawMaterial = Product::where('id', $bom->raw_material_product_id)
                        ->where('is_active', true)
                        ->lockForUpdate()
                        ->firstOrFail();

                    $qtyWasted = bcmul($failedOutputQty, (string) $bom->consumption_qty, 4);

                    if (bccomp($qtyWasted, '0.0000', 4) !== 1) {
                        throw new \DomainException('Kuantitas kerusakan bahan baku tidak valid.');
                    }

                    $items[] = $this->buildItem($rawMaterial, $qtyWasted);
                    $totalCost = bcadd($totalCost, $items[array_key_last($items)]['subtotal'], 4);
                }
            } elseif (! empty($data->directItems)) {
                $usedProductIds = [];

                foreach ($data->directItems as $directItem) {
                    $product = Product::where('id', $directItem['product_id'] ?? 0)
                        ->where('is_active', true)
                        ->lockForUpdate()
                        ->firstOrFail();

                    if (isset($usedProductIds[$product->id])) {
                        throw new \DomainException('Produk yang sama tidak boleh muncul lebih dari satu kali pada daftar kerusakan.');
                    }

                    $usedProductIds[$product->id] = true;

                    // HPP selalu diambil dari master produk, bukan dari input klien.
                    $qtyWasted = $this->normalizePositiveQty(
                        (string) ($directItem['qty_wasted'] ?? ''),
                        'Kuantitas kerusakan ' . $product->name
                    );

                    $items[] = $this->buildItem($product, $qtyWasted);
                    $totalCost = bcadd($totalCost, $items[array_key_last($items)]['subtotal'], 4);
                }
            } else {
                throw new \DomainException('Tidak ada item kerusakan yang dicatat.');
            }

            $spoilageNumber = $this->nextSpoilageNumber();

            $spoilageLog = SpoilageLog::create([
                'spoilage_number' => $spoilageNumber,
                'pos_shift_id' => $posShift->id,
                'spoilage_source' => $data->spoilageSource,
                'service_id' => $data->serviceId,
                'failed_output_qty' => $failedOutputQty,
                'reason_category' => $data->reasonCategory->value,
                'reason_description' => $data->reasonDescription,
                'total_spoilage_cost' => $totalCost,
                'reported_by_user_id' => $data->reportedByUserId,
                'verified_by_user_id' => $data->verifiedByUserId,
                'journal_entry_id' => null,
                'logged_at' => Carbon::now(),
            ]);

            // Tulis spoilage_log_items dan stock_ledger_entries.
            foreach ($items as $item) {
                /** @var Product $product */
                $product = $item['product'];

                SpoilageLogItem::create([
                    'spoilage_log_id' => $spoilageLog->id,
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'qty_wasted' => $item['qty_wasted'],
                    'unit_cost_at_spoilage' => $item['unit_cost'],
                    'subtotal_cost' => $item['subtotal'],
                ]);

                StockLedgerEntry::create([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'pos_shift_id' => $posShift->id,
                    'reference_type' => 'SPOILAGE',
                    'reference_id' => $spoilageLog->id,
                    'qty_change' => '-' . $item['qty_wasted'],
                    'balance_before' => $item['balance_before'],
                    'balance_after' => $item['balance_after'],
                    'unit_cost' => $item['unit_cost'],
                    'total_value' => $item['subtotal'],
                    'created_by' => $data->reportedByUserId,
                    'created_at' => Carbon::now(),
                ]);
            }

            if (bccomp($totalCost, '0.0000', 4) !== 1) {
                return $spoilageLog->fresh(['items.product', 'journalEntry']);
            }

            $period = AccountingPeriod::where('is_closed', false)
                ->orderBy('start_date', 'desc')
                ->first();

            if ($period === null) {
                throw new \DomainException('Tidak ada periode akuntansi terbuka untuk mencatat kerusakan.');
            }

            $journalLines = [];
            $expenseByAccount = [];
            $inventoryByAccount = [];

            foreach ($items as $item) {
                /** @var Product $product */
                $product = $item['product'];
                $inventoryCode = $product->inventoryAccount?->account_code
                    ?? ($product->inventory_type->value === 'RETAIL' ? '1-1301' : '1-1302');
                $expenseCode = $product->inventory_type->value === 'RETAIL' ? '6-1102' : '6-1101';

                $expenseByAccount[$expenseCode] = bcadd(
                    $expenseByAccount[$expenseCode] ?? '0.0000',
                    $item['subtotal'],
                    4
                );
                $inventoryByAccount[$inventoryCode] = bcadd(
                    $inventoryByAccount[$inventoryCode] ?? '0.0000',
                    $item['subtotal'],
                    4
                );
            }

            foreach ($expenseByAccount as $code => $amount) {
                if (bccomp($amount, '0.0000', 4) === 1) {
                    $journalLines[] = new JournalLineData(
                        chartOfAccountCode: $code,
                        debit: $amount,
                        credit: '0.0000',
                        lineDescription: 'Debit Beban Kerusakan / Kegagalan Produksi',
                    );
                }
            }

            foreach ($inventoryByAccount as $code => $amount) {
                if (bccomp($amount, '0.0000', 4) === 1) {
                    $journalLines[] = new JournalLineData(
                        chartOfAccountCode: $code,
                        debit: '0.0000',
                        credit: $amount,
                        lineDescription: 'Kredit Persediaan Tersedia',
                    );
                }
            }

            $journalData = new JournalEntryData(
                journalNumber: $this->nextJournalNumber(),
                accountingPeriodId: (string) $period->getKey(),
                posShiftId: (string) $posShift->id,
                entryDate: Carbon::now(),
                journalType: JournalType::SPOILAGE,
                referenceType: 'App\Models\SpoilageLog',
                referenceId: $spoilageLog->id,
                description: 'Barang rusak / gagal produksi: ' . $data->reasonDescription .
                    ' (total Rp ' . $totalCost . ')',
                lines: $journalLines,
                createdByUserId: $data->reportedByUserId,
            );

            $journalEntry = app(\App\Actions\Accounting\PostDoubleEntryJournalAction::class)
                ->execute($journalData);

            $spoilageLog->update(['journal_entry_id' => $journalEntry->id]);

            return $spoilageLog->fresh(['items.product', 'journalEntry']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * @return array{product: Product, qty_wasted: string, unit_cost: string, subtotal: string, balance_before: string, balance_after: string}
     */
    private function buildItem(Product $product, string $qtyWasted): array
    {
        $unitCost = (string) $product->average_cost;
        $subtotal = bcmul($qtyWasted, $unitCost, 4);
        $balanceBefore = (string) $product->current_stock;

        if (bccomp($balanceBefore, $qtyWasted, 4) === -1) {
            throw new \DomainException(
                'Stok tidak mencukupi untuk pencatatan kerusakan: ' .
                $product->name . ' (tersedia: ' . $balanceBefore . ', dibutuhkan: ' . $qtyWasted . ')'
            );
        }

        $balanceAfter = bcsub($balanceBefore, $qtyWasted, 4);

        $product->update(['current_stock' => $balanceAfter]);

        return [
            'product' => $product,
            'qty_wasted' => $qtyWasted,
            'unit_cost' => $unitCost,
            'subtotal' => $subtotal,
            'balance_before' => $balanceBefore,
            'balance_after' => $balanceAfter,
        ];
    }

    private function normalizePositiveQty(string $value, string $label): string
    {
        $value = trim($value);

        if ($value === '' || ! preg_match('/^\d+(\.\d{1,4})?$/', $value)) {
            throw new \DomainException($label . ' tidak valid.');
        }

        $normalized = number_format((float) $value, 4, '.', '');

        if (bccomp($normalized, '0.0000', 4) !== 1) {
            throw new \DomainException($label . ' harus lebih besar dari nol.');
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    private function nextSpoilageNumber(): string
    {
        $sequence = SpoilageLog::count() + 1;

        do {
            $spoilageNumber = 'SPL-' . Carbon::now()->format('Ymd') . '-'
                . str_pad((string) $sequence, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
            $sequence++;
        } while (SpoilageLog::where('spoilage_number', $spoilageNumber)->exists());

        return $spoilageNumber;
    }

    private function nextJournalNumber(): string
    {
        $sequence = JournalEntry::count() + 1;

        do {
            $journalNumber = 'JRN-' . Carbon::now()->format('Ymd') . '-'
                . str_pad((string) $sequence, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
            $sequence++;
        } while (JournalEntry::where('journal_number', $journalNumber)->exists());

        return $journalNumber;
    }
}

## Objective
- Harden BESTCO numeric/money inputs and role-aware user management with exactly one superadmin, then deep-test all modules and fix verified errors, bugs, illogical logic, ambiguities, and anomalies.
- Produce a brief final report in Indonesian.

## Requirements
- Numeric/currency inputs reject letters and `-`, `,`, `.`, `;`, `[`, `]`; enforce frontend and backend.
- Role hierarchy: superadmin manages all; admin manages `piket_guru` + `piket_siswa`; `piket_guru` manages `piket_siswa`; students manage nobody.
- Only one superadmin account; cannot create or promote another superadmin.
- Deactivate accounts instead of hard delete; block self-deactivation and removal of the last active superadmin.
- Preserve POS layout, modal behavior, logo `public/img/best.png`, existing routes, Livewire bindings, form field names, print behavior, and theme tokens.
- POS: only product list scrolls; header/search/cart stay fixed.
- Popups overlay the full viewport and are centered.
- Use concise, professional Indonesian UI copy.
- Deep-test all modules, fix verified issues, add regression coverage, and report findings briefly.
- Do not commit unless asked.

## Decisions
- Role hierarchy lives in `UserRole::level()`, `UserRole::manageableRoles()`, `UserRole::assignableRoles()`, and `User::canManageUsers()` / `canManageUser()`.
- Single-superadmin rule: `UserRole::assignableRoles()` excludes `SUPERADMIN`; `UserController::assignableRoles()` allows self-edit to retain the current role only.
- Admin has master-data access; `piket_guru` is operational/shift-focused and cannot modify master data.
- Canonical numeric guard is `resources/js/numeric-input.js`, imported by `resources/js/app.js`; duplicate layout script removed.
- Numeric inputs use `type="text"` + `inputmode`; decimals allowed only when step contains `.`; PIN preserves leading zeros and respects `maxlength`.
- `.page-enter` remains free of persistent `transform`; global dialog uses `z-[9999]`.
- POS full-height layout applies only at `lg` and above.
- User-management validation messages are localized to Indonesian; global app locale remains `en`.
- Audit approach: inspect controllers/actions/services/Livewire/views, reproduce suspected issues with targeted tests, fix only confirmed defects, then rerun full suite/build/browser checks.
- Authorization boundary: `/transactions` is staff-only; `/shift` POST routes are staff-only; `/shift` GET stays available to students in read-only mode because `EnsureActiveShift` redirects them there.
- Shift rule: exactly 3 slots with distinct active `piket_siswa`; supervisor must be an active `piket_guru`; only staff may open/close shifts.
- Cash rule: physical expected cash uses only account `1-1101`; QRIS `1-1103` is excluded.
- Discount rule: cart-level manual discount is always applied and allocated proportionally between retail `4-1102` and service `4-2109`.
- Void rule: restore stock at original snapshot cost; reverse in the current open period when the original period is closed.
- Payment rule: cash may exceed grand total; QRIS/transfer must equal grand total; grand total must be positive.
- Inventory funding accounts are restricted: restock/inbound use `1-1102` or `2-1101`; initial stock may also use `3-1101`.
- Spoilage costs are derived from product master `average_cost`, never client-supplied `unit_cost`; retail spoilage uses `6-1102` / `1-1301`, raw-material spoilage uses `6-1101` / `1-1302`.
- Initial stock always creates a stock-ledger row, even when HPP is zero; journal posting is skipped when inventory value is zero.
- Purchase prices and purchase totals must be positive; duplicate products in batch inbound are rejected.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added `UserController`, `users.*` routes, sidebar/user-menu links, page label, and `users/index`, `users/create`, `users/edit`, shared `_form`.
- Added `tests/Feature/UserManagementTest.php` and `tests/Unit/StrictInputRulesTest.php`.
- Enforced single superadmin: create form no longer offers Superadmin; backend rejects creating/promoting another superadmin; self-edit keeps `superadmin`.
- Browser-verified 800px/1440px layouts, create/edit forms, role toggles, PIN filtering, modal overlay, and Indonesian validation messages.
- Fixed `FinancialStatementGenerator` account names, discount accounts, BKU chronological running balances, report tab/date validation, reversing journal period/double-reversal guards, void snapshot-cost restoration, and cash-only expected cash.
- Added staff-only middleware to `/shift/open`, `/shift/close`, `/transactions`, and `/transactions/{id}/void`; `/shift` GET remains student-readable.
- Added `EnsureAccountIsActive` middleware and registered it on the web middleware group.
- Added `PosTerminal::boot()` authorization for active users and active student operators.
- Reworked `ShiftController::index()` fallback to one student per grade X/XI/XII.
- Rewrote `OpenPosShiftAction`, hardened `ClosePosShiftAction`, and rewrote `CheckoutPosTransactionAction` validation, discount allocation, ledger references, and cashier authorization.
- Fixed `User::hasAnyRole()` to accept both `string` and `UserRole` values.
- Updated tests for stricter shift/checkout rules:
  - `PiketShiftTest` now uses staff openers and 3 distinct students.
  - `PosTerminalAndReportTest` opens shifts via helper with 3 distinct students.
  - `NewModulesFeatureTest` uses 3 distinct students and staff opener.
  - `BestcoCoreBusinessTest` adds a `ShiftAttendance` row for the student cashier.
  - `UserManagementTest` bypasses `EnsureAccountIsActive` only for the controller-level last-superadmin guard test.
- Subset after enum/test fixes: 43 tests passed (208 assertions).
- Inventory hardening completed:
  - Funding-account whitelists in `InventoryController`, `StockInboundController`, and actions.
  - `UpdateServiceAction` / `CreateServiceAction` validate raw-material type, active status, positive quantities, and duplicate BOM rows.
  - Spoilage derives costs server-side, validates open shift, and credits correct inventory accounts.
  - Restock ledger now references the journal ID; batch inbound rejects duplicate products and zero/negative prices.
  - `CreateProductAction` always writes initial-stock ledger and only posts journal for positive value.
  - `MutateRetailToRawMaterialAction` validates positive quantities, active products, open shift, product inventory accounts, and open accounting period.
- Seeder now uses `today()->dayOfWeekIso`.
- Converted numeric/PIN inputs in `inventory/index.blade.php`, `inventory/inbound.blade.php`, `shift/index.blade.php`, `transactions/index.blade.php`, POS modals, and user PIN form.
- Shift page now hides open/close forms from students, hides “Buka kasir” for non-operators, and shows a read-only “Shift belum dibuka” card.
- Inventory/Bestco subset after inventory changes: 15 tests passed (70 assertions).
- `npm run build` succeeded earlier; latest assets before newest view edits were `app-BcHxhZMY.css` and `app-Bx4MUre5.js`.

### Active
- Run the full test suite after the latest inventory, spoilage, mutation, seeder, and Blade changes.
- Add focused regression tests for student access, duplicate open shifts, QRIS expected cash, BKU backdated ordering, discounted income statement, void snapshot/period, Sunday schedule matching, and checkout validation.
- Verify Blade compilation/view cache and rerun `npm run build`.
- Recheck affected browser flows at 800px and 1440px.
- Write the brief Indonesian final report.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `php -l` on all modified PHP files and `php artisan test --compact`; fix any regressions.
2. Add focused regression tests for authorization boundaries, duplicate open shifts, QRIS expected cash, BKU ordering, discounted reports, void valuation/period, Sunday schedule matching, checkout discounts/payments, and inventory funding/BOM validation.
3. Run `php artisan view:clear`, `php artisan view:cache`, and `npm run build`.
4. Recheck affected browser flows at 800px and 1440px.
5. Write the brief Indonesian report; do not commit.

## Relevant Files
- `app/Actions/Pos/CheckoutPosTransactionAction.php`: checkout validation, discount allocation, ledger references, cashier authorization.
- `app/Actions/Pos/VoidPosTransactionAction.php`: snapshot-cost restoration and cash-only reversal.
- `app/Actions/Piket/OpenPosShiftAction.php`: single open shift, 3 distinct slots, role/status validation.
- `app/Actions/Piket/ClosePosShiftAction.php`: cash-only expected cash and open-period discrepancy handling.
- `app/Actions/Inventory/RecordSpoilageAction.php`: server-side spoilage costs and account mapping.
- `app/Actions/Inventory/RecordPurchaseRestockAction.php`: funding whitelist, positive totals, ledger reference.
- `app/Actions/Inventory/RecordBatchPurchaseInboundAction.php`: duplicate product rejection, funding whitelist, ledger reference.
- `app/Actions/Inventory/CreateProductAction.php`: initial-stock ledger even at zero HPP.
- `app/Http/Controllers/InventoryController.php`: master-data validation and BOM/funding rules.
- `app/Http/Controllers/StockInboundController.php`: batch inbound validation.
- `app/Models/User.php`: role hierarchy and `hasAnyRole()` compatibility.
- `app/Http/Controllers/ShiftController.php`: grade-aware defaults and stricter open/close validation.
- `resources/views/shift/index.blade.php`: student read-only shift UI and numeric/PIN attributes.
- `resources/views/inventory/index.blade.php`: converted numeric inputs and funding/BOM forms.
- `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php`: ISO weekday seeding.

## Important Context
- Latest commit is `6479209`; all current work is uncommitted. Do not commit unless explicitly asked.
- Full suite before latest fixes was 7 failed / 78 passed / 374 assertions; failures were enum TypeError plus old shift/checkout test setup. Targeted subsets now pass.
- Current DB has 14 users: 1 superadmin, 1 admin, 3 `piket_guru`, 9 `piket_siswa`.
- All seeded passwords are `password`; staff PIN is `123456`; students have no PIN.
- Login accepts username, `nip_nisn`, or email; superadmin `SA001`, admin `AD001`, guru `GURU001..003`, students `NISNX001...`.
- `ChartOfAccount` uses column `account_name`; remaining `->name` references should be checked.
- `PostDoubleEntryJournalAction` writes BKU entries for every `CASH_BANK` journal line, including QRIS; close-shift filters `1-1101`.
- `StrictCurrency` allows max 2 decimals; `StrictQuantity` allows max 4 decimals.
- `public/js/currency-input-guard.js` is still tracked but unreferenced; do not re-add a duplicate script tag.
- App locale is `en`; only user-management validation messages are localized.
- In-app browser viewport is about 800 CSS px; use temp CDP scripts for 1440px checks: `C:\Users\HYPE AMD\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\cdp-users-check.mjs` and `cdp-pos-check.mjs`.
- Latest build assets are stale relative to newest Blade edits; rebuild before browser verification.
